ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Explicit Euler at step 0.05s, initial volume 1 pL, impermeant amount 300 fmol, water coefficient 0.002 pL/(s mM). External concentrations 150, 300, 450 mM produce swelling, no change, and shrinking under equal hydrostatic pressures. Dotted volume lines show equilibria. These are ideal synthetic scenarios, not predictions of cell survival or lysis.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Osmotic volume and concentration trajectories
